affected_region_description: Granite Ridge and Pine Ridge foothills
storm_notes: Cold front with 65 mph gusts and heavy wet snow above 2,500 ft. Most damage from falling oak and pine limbs in the Granite Ridge high fire threat area; Emergency Operations Center activated at level 2.
Two-day atmospheric river with 5 in of rain; localized flooding of pad-mount equipment and saturated soils causing tree failures in the valley and riverside districts.
